title: Vertex prism on internal function complexes of profinite parameters
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring on the small coherent profinite site [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, def-weil-size-convention], and let $M$ be an internal $A$-module [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. For a profinite set $Z$, including the empty set, let
$$B_Z^n(M)=\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A(A[\underline Z^{n+1}],M),\qquad n\geq0,$$
with $A[P]$ and generalized evaluation as in [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data]. Put $B_Z^n(M)=0$ for $n<0$ and give it differential
$$(\delta F)(z_0,\ldots,z_{n+1})=\sum_{j=0}^{n+1}(-1)^jF(z_0,\ldots,\widehat z_j,\ldots,z_{n+1}).$$
For profinite sets $X,Y$ and continuous maps $u,v:X\to Y$, coordinatewise pullback gives internal $A$-linear cochain maps $u^*,v^*:B_Y^\bullet(M)\to B_X^\bullet(M)$. Set $P_{u,v,0}=0$ and, for $n\geq1$, prescribe
$$(P_{u,v,n}F)(x_0,\ldots,x_{n-1})=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}(-1)^iF(u(x_0),\ldots,u(x_i),v(x_i),\ldots,v(x_{n-1})).$$
These define internal $A$-linear maps $P_{u,v,n}:B_Y^n(M)\to B_X^{n-1}(M)$ satisfying
$$\delta P_{u,v}+P_{u,v}\delta=v^*-u^*$$
in every nonnegative degree. All formulas and identities hold on generalized evaluations after every profinite base change. They commute with every internal $A$-linear coefficient map $M\to N$. They are also natural in the two parameter maps: for continuous $b:W\to X$ and $c:Y\to Z$, one has $b^*P_{u,v}=P_{u\circ b,v\circ b}$ and $P_{u,v}c^*=P_{c\circ u,c\circ v}$ with the indicated function complexes as domains and codomains. In degree zero the identity reads $(P_{u,v,1}\delta F)(x)=F(v(x))-F(u(x))$. No group action or resolution is required.

proof.text: For each continuous parameter map q:P→Q, precompose every generalized function by q, over every slice T→S, and apply the inverse of F.evaluate to construct parameterValue. The F.add, F.smul and F.restriction laws show that it is a linear map of section-module sheaves. The fully faithful internal-to-section-module functor gives its internal module morphism. F.map gives coefficient naturality. Injectivity of F.evaluate gives the identity and composition laws; this constructs the actual contravariant parameterFunctor without choosing an unspecified witness.

proof.text: Form the simplicial profinite object of nonempty tuples. Its right-opposite followed by parameterFunctor is cosimplicial. Mathlib AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.d_squared proves that the alternating deletion maps square to zero. Construct the coefficient functor tupleComplex using CochainComplex.of and CochainComplex.ofHom. Its term identifications are identity isomorphisms. Coordinatewise parameter maps commute with deletion, giving tuplePullback as a natural transformation of complex functors.

proof.text: Construct each prism as the finite signed sum of the internal maps induced by continuous vertex insertions. The evaluation is additive, hence respects integer scalar multiplication and finite sums. The parameterMap evaluation formula therefore proves precisely the displayed differential, pullback and vertex-prism formulas on every slice. Naturality of the parameter transformations proves coefficient naturality.

proof.text: Apply the generic preadditive prism_boundary to parameterFunctor and then evaluate at M to obtain identity_succ. The separately proved degree-zero equation prism_boundary_zero is the two deletions of the unique inserted pair, yielding pullback by v minus pullback by u.

proof.text: The coordinate identities for insertion imply prism_source and prism_target by contravariant functoriality and bilinearity; evaluate their natural transformations at M. Finally apply additive generalized evaluation to the degree-zero morphism equation and use the two coordinate pullback formulas to obtain degree_zero_formula. The construction has no nonemptiness, resolution or group-action hypothesis.

The statement is the one imported from live, unchanged (live has the item unsplit, with no repair note). It is well-typed: P_n goes from B_Y^n to B_X^{n-1}. I checked by hand, and by my own formal Z-coefficient check in degrees 0-6, that δP+Pδ=v*-u*, including the degree-0 formula. Edge cases hold: u=v, X or Y empty (the empty family covers ∅ in the coherent site), zero ring or module. Step 1: lem-sfb-profinite-free-hom-resolution-evaluation states the iso H_P(N)(S)≅N(S×P) with exactly the restriction, precomposition, A(S)-action and N-naturality the step uses. Only its underived part is used. def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data gives generalized evaluation; normalization and detection of equality are Yoneda. Step 2: the maps are precompositions with A[d_j], A[u^{n+1}], A[h_i], so they are internal morphisms. Steps 3-5: I checked the δ² pairing, the identities d_j h_i = h_{i-1}d_j (j<i) and h_i d_{j-1} (j>i+1) with opposite signs, the bijection onto the δP_n terms and the diagonal telescoping. They follow Stacks simplicial.tex equation-homotopy-to-homotopy and lemma-homotopy-s-N (Tag 019S, checked in tags/tags), where the sums are left to the reader; here they are written out. proof_origin is agent, which is correct for this adaptation. Step 7: I checked coefficient, parameter (b, c) and base-change naturality directly. proof_deps equals the union of uses; there is no cycle; both cited nodes are in the same unit (sk-thm-sf-ctf-stability), so no tool_uses are needed. No duplicate: the DAG prism/homotopy nodes (simplicial-homotopy-free-chain, coef extra-degeneracy prism, trf coefficient-bar prism, poset interval nullhomotopy, homogeneous-bar normalization) state other things. Batch 5: the flagged path reaches lem-trf-free-module-sheaf-universal-property. It is the generic Stacks 04BL free module-sheaf universal property, not a statement or proof step of the trace formula or Poincaré duality, so this is not a reason to return. No SGA is cited. No changes made.
